metadata.question: Does New Delhi show less fog coverage compared to its surrounding areas such as Modinagar and Greater Noida in January 30, 2014?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare fog coverage in New Delhi vs surrounding areas (Modinagar, Greater Noida) - Date: January 30, 2014 - Fog is often detected using thermal bands or by analyzing cloud/aerosol products - For fog detection, I can use Landsat 8 or MODIS data. Landsat 8 has thermal bands useful for fog detection - Fog typically appears as low clouds/high moisture near surface - can use brightness temperature difference or visual/NIR bands 2. Masking strategy: - The question IS about fog/clouds, so I should NOT mask clouds - Instead, I need to detect fog presence - Fog detection methods: * Temperature inversion (thermal bands) * Low brightness temperature * High reflectance in visible but low in SWIR - For simplicity, I'll use a fog index or analyze cloud optical thickness from MODIS 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - If no data available for the date/location -> C1 - If data exists but no valid pixels after processing -> C2 - If calculation returns None/NaN -> C3 - Otherwise compare fog coverage values between New Delhi center and surrounding areas - "Less fog" means lower fog coverage/frequency in New Delhi compared to surroundings ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const newDelhi = ee.Geometry.Point([77.2090, 28.6139]); const modinagar = ee.Geometry.Point([77.5833, 28.8333]); const greaterNoida = ee.Geometry.Point([77.5340, 28.4744]); const surroundingRegion = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [77.4, 28.4], [77.7, 28.4], [77.7, 28.9], [77.4, 28.9], [77.4, 28.4] ]); const newDelhiRegion = ee.Geometry.Point([77.2090, 28.6139]).buffer(10000); const startDate = '2014-01-30'; const endDate = '2014-01-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Try MODIS Terra Daily Surface Reflectance let collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD09GA') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(newDelhi); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log('MODIS images found:', size); if (size === 0) { // Try Landsat 8 collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_TOA') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(newDelhi); const landsatSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log('Landsat 8 images found:', landsatSize); if (landsatSize === 0) { console.log('No data available for January 30, 2014'); console.log('C1'); return; } } const image = collection.first(); // 3. Fog detection using visible and NIR bands // For MODIS: use state_1km band which contains cloud mask info const cloudMask = image.select('state_1km'); // Bit 0-1: cloud state (00=clear, 01=cloudy, 10=mixed, 11=not set) // Bit 10: internal cloud algorithm flag const cloudBit = cloudMask.bitwiseAnd(3); // Get bits 0-1 // Consider cloudy pixels as potential fog (low-level clouds in winter) const fogMask = cloudBit.gte(1); // 4. Calculate fog coverage for New Delhi const newDelhiStats = fogMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: newDelhiRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const newDelhiFog = newDelhiStats.get('state_1km').getInfo(); const newDelhiCount = fogMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: newDelhiRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('state_1km').getInfo(); console.log('New Delhi valid pixels:', newDelhiCount); if (newDelhiCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in New Delhi region'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Calculate fog coverage for surrounding areas const surroundingStats = fogMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: surroundingRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const surroundingFog = surroundingStats.get('state_1km').getInfo(); const surroundingCount = fogMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: surroundingRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('state_1km').getInfo(); console.log('Surrounding area valid pixels:', surroundingCount); if (surroundingCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in surrounding region'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (newDelhiFog === null || surroundingFog === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null values'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log('New Delhi fog coverage:', (newDelhiFog * 100).toFixed(2) + '%'); console.log('Surrounding fog coverage:', (surroundingFog * 100).toFixed(2) + '%'); if (newDelhiFog < surroundingFog) { console.log('New Delhi shows LESS fog than surrounding areas'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('New Delhi does NOT show less fog than surrounding areas'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
